Code block inside a blockquote keeps its line indentation

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<blockquote><pre><code>line1\n    line2 indented</code></pre></blockquote>", 0);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
